sloka: एषा सा दृश्यते ऽयोध्या राजधानी पितुर्मम् ।अयोध्यां कुरु वैदेहि प्रणामं पुनरागता ।। ६.१२६.५२ ।।
transliteration: eṣā sā dṛśyate 'yodhyā rājadhānī piturmam ।ayodhyāṁ kuru vaidehi praṇāmaṁ punarāgatā ।। 6.126.52 ।।

translations.english: "There are seen the abodes of ascetics. Here was seen by you hermitage of Atri (whose wife Anasuya you had seen) glowing like sun and fire."
